tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The ground, a deep harbour navy: the server rail, the user panel, text-field wells and code blocks. Everything else sits on it.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Side panes: the channel sidebar and the member list; cards such as the sign-in card.

tokens.name: panel-raised
tokens.usage: The channel itself (header, messages, composer area); hover fill of rows on `panel`.

tokens.name: panel-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of a message row on `panel-raised`: one quiet step down, so a hovered message reads as picked out, not selected.

tokens.name: panel-active
tokens.usage: The selected channel row, secondary button fills. Every ink token reads on it (`muted` 5.3:1).

tokens.name: floating
tokens.usage: Tooltips, popovers, menus and the message toolbar, anything that floats above the panes; always with `shadow-float`.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a Modal: the panes dimmed toward `floating`, so the dialog is the one lit surface and the app stays recognisable behind it.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: The 1px seams between panes and under every 48px header. An alias of `bg`, so a seam reads as the ground showing through.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text and message content, on every surface (10.6:1 or more). A cool off-white, never pure.

tokens.name: text-strong
tokens.usage: Names, headings, the selected channel, unread marks and avatar initials; on every surface and every avatar fill (5.1:1 or more).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: channel names at rest, labels, timestamps, topics, section headings, placeholders, idle icons. On every surface (5.3:1 or more) and on the accent tint (4.8:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Snatter azure, the brand colour and the start of the sheen: primary buttons, the selected tab and server, focus. Labels on it are `on-accent`, dark, never white. Reads as ink on every surface too (6.4:1 or more).

tokens.name: accent-sheen
tokens.usage: The cyan the azure turns into: the end of `gradient-accent`. Not a flat fill on its own. As ink it reads on every surface (7.3:1 or more).

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Solid azure where a gradient can't go: a 1px focused-field border, an unread badge. `on-accent` on it (6.6:1).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent as ink: links, mentions, a pressed toggle's icon. An alias of `accent`, which already holds 6.4:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring: a 2px solid azure outline, 2px out, 6.4:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Azure tint behind content: the callout, a highlighted row. Every ink token reads on it (`text` 9.5:1, `muted` 4.8:1).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on `accent`, `accent-sheen`, `accent-strong` and anything filled with `gradient-accent` (6.6:1 or more): a deep navy ink, never white.

tokens.name: online
tokens.usage: The presence dot of an online member. Only that: never text alone, never an action (7.0:1 or more as a mark).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Lamp yellow: notices as text on the panes (8.3:1 or more), the reconnecting banner's fill, and the mention highlight.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `warning` fill (11.6:1).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind a warning callout; the mention highlight starts from it (`gradient-mention`). `text` on it.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error as a mark: an invalid field's border, a destructive icon. Keep error copy in `danger-text`; `danger` is only 3.9:1 on `panel-active`.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Error messages as text, on every surface and on `danger-soft` (5.8:1 or more).

tokens.name: danger-strong
tokens.usage: Fill of a destructive button (ban, delete) with an `on-danger` label (5.3:1).

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Labels on `danger-strong` (5.3:1).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind an invalid field's glow and a message that failed to send.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: The platform's own UI face at a 15px base. Weight carries hierarchy, not size: most of the app is 15px.

styles.name: text-title
styles.usage: Screen titles: the community name on the sign-in card. One per screen.

styles.name: text-heading
styles.usage: Pane headings and names: the community name, the channel in its header, card and callout titles, message authors, member names.

styles.name: text-body
styles.sample: Anyone up for a round after dinner?
styles.usage: Message content, input text and everything without a better style. Buttons and tabs take it at weight 500.

styles.name: text-label
styles.usage: Form labels, above their input, in `muted`.

styles.name: text-small
styles.sample: The account you create now becomes the owner.
styles.usage: Helper copy: callout bodies, field hints and errors, channel topics, tooltips (at 500).

styles.name: text-eyebrow
styles.usage: Group headings in the member list, uppercase, in `muted`.

styles.name: text-caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, the typing line, presence under a name, counts.

styles.name: text-code
styles.usage: Inline code and code blocks in messages, on a `bg` fill with `radius-sm`.

spacing.note: Named by their pixel value. Mostly a 4px rhythm, with the 6px and 10px steps rows and controls use.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Nudges: the status dot's offset past an avatar's edge, stacked message rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Label to input, member row padding, icon-button padding, the tab track's inset.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Channel row padding (vertical), icon to channel name.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: The default gap: between rail icons, inside lists, between a name and its timestamp.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Button padding (vertical), the user panel's padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between form fields, pane header side padding, the rail's top and bottom.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Message gutter, button padding (horizontal), between a card's blocks.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Card padding; the gap before a new message group.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Screen margins around the sign-in card.

radius.note: Small and soft for controls; round for people. A server icon is a circle that settles into a rounded square when you reach for it.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, channel and member rows, icon buttons, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, callouts, the composer, tooltips, the tab track.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: A server icon while hovered or selected.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Avatars and a server icon at rest; animates cleanly to `radius-lg`.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The rail's selection pill, typing dots, skeleton lines, counts.

shadow.note: Dark UIs show depth through surface steps first. Shadows are for things that float or lift, and are cast in deep navy, not pure black; the accent ones glow.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: A card standing on the ground: the sign-in card, dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Tooltips, popovers, menus and a message's hover toolbar. The 1px ring edges them on any pane.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: The soft azure halo around a focused text field or composer, outside its sheen edge.

tokens.name: shadow-glow-danger
tokens.usage: The halo around an invalid field, outside its `danger` border.

tokens.name: shadow-accent
tokens.usage: The azure glow under a hovered primary button and the selected server: light from the sheen spilling onto the ground.

gradient.note: The sheen is Snatter's signature: azure turning cyan, like harbour lights on water. It covers what is chosen or primary and nothing else. The other gradients are glows and fades, never decoration. `bundle.css` builds each one from the colour tokens, so a theme added later gets its own.

tokens.name: gradient-accent
tokens.usage: The sheen. Primary buttons, the selected tab, a hovered or selected server, the rail pill, focused-field edges and the typing dots. Paint it wider than the control (150%) so a hover can slide it toward `accent-sheen`. `on-accent` holds 6.6:1 or more across it.

tokens.name: gradient-edge
tokens.usage: A 1px sheen along the top edge of a card on the ground. It marks the one surface a screen is about.

tokens.name: gradient-backdrop
tokens.usage: Over `bg` behind the sign-in card: an azure glow from the top left. Layer it with `gradient-backdrop-far`.

tokens.name: gradient-backdrop-far
tokens.usage: The cyan glow from the bottom right that answers `gradient-backdrop`.

tokens.name: gradient-mention
tokens.usage: A message that mentions you: warm at the gutter where the eye scans, fading across the line.

tokens.name: gradient-shimmer
tokens.usage: The highlight that sweeps across a skeleton while content loads.

size.note: The fixed frame of the app shell.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: The server rail.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: The channel sidebar, expanded.

tokens.name: sidebar-collapsed
tokens.usage: The channel sidebar collapsed to icons.

tokens.name: members-width
tokens.usage: The member list.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Every pane header: the community name, the channel header.

tokens.name: server-icon
tokens.usage: A server in the rail.

tokens.name: avatar-md
tokens.usage: Avatars in the member list and user panel.

tokens.name: avatar-lg
tokens.usage: The author avatar at the head of a message group.

tokens.name: icon-size
tokens.usage: Inline icons: channel type, header actions.

duration.note: Hover answers at once, a choice settles a little slower, and layout moves slowest.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Hover fills and colour, press feedback.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Focus glows, tooltips, icon colour, fades in and out.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Selection moving: the tab indicator, the rail pill, a server icon's shape; entrances of messages and banners.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Layout: panes collapsing, opening and closing; a card entering.

tokens.name: duration-loop
tokens.usage: One cycle of an ambient loop: typing dots; the skeleton sweep runs at the same length.

easing.note: Four curves. Standard for anything that moves between two states, out for arrivals, in for departures, spring only for small marks.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Hovers, selections, layout. The default.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Things arriving: a message, a card, a banner, a tooltip.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Things leaving: a tooltip or popover closing.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Small marks that confirm a choice: the rail pill, the tab indicator, the send button appearing. Never on panes or text.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: A disabled control, as a whole.

tokens.name: opacity-offline
tokens.usage: An offline member's avatar. Not the name: it goes `muted`, which stays legible.
